Lena (CS): Heads-up: BrightLayer hitting 429s during quickstart when calling embeddings in parallel from serverless workers. They used js-sdk v1.2.0 with ephemeral demo tokens. Seen after ~6 warmup calls. Can someone look?

Arjun (SE): Thanks. Are they creating a new SDK client per invocation? Serverless cold starts often do that and cause preflight/auth fanout.

Lena (CS): Customer says each lambda creates a client on coldstart and calls embeddings twice. Logs pasted below.

```
2025-01-09T14:02:10Z INFO lambda coldstart
2025-01-09T14:02:10Z DEBUG auth: ephemeral request -> 200
2025-01-09T14:02:10Z DEBUG preflight: /v1/prefetch -> 200
2025-01-09T14:02:11Z INFO embeddings: batch start
2025-01-09T14:02:11Z WARN response: 429 Too Many Requests (rate window)
2025-01-09T14:02:11Z INFO retry: jittered backoff 150ms
2025-01-09T14:02:12Z WARN response: 429 Too Many Requests
```

Priya (SDK): Quick hypotheses: (1) ephemeral token refresh + parallel coldstarts -> auth fanout; (2) they're hitting the per-account low-priority embeddings window (our embeddings prewarm quota is smaller); (3) js-sdk v1.2.0 doesn't coalesce preflight across forked runtimes.

Jordan (Eng): Which region/edge and account id? ops-bot can provide current window settings.

Lena (CS): eu-central-1, account brightlayer-prod.

ops-bot: Account windows: embeddings_prefetch: 3 req/s (default). Active feature flag: ephemeral_demo_tokens=true.

Priya (SDK): Recommendations to unblock immediately:
- Use a single SDK client per lambda container (reuse across invocations) instead of per-request. Example snippet for async handler reuse: `let client; export default async function handler(ev){ client = client || new Redwood(); await client.embeddings.create(...); }`
- Upgrade to js-sdk v1.3.1 (coalescing + improved keepalive).
- Add randomized start jitter on coldstart to spread out preflight calls (e.g., sleep random 0-300ms)
- As a dev-only test, they can set REDWOOD_SKIP_PREFETCH=true in their dev env to see nominal behavior (do not recommend for prod).

Arjun (SE): Could we temporarily increase their embeddings_prefetch window while they validate?

Jordan (Eng): I can grant a 15m bump to 8 req/s for brightlayer-prod. Ops needs confirmation.

ops-bot: Temporary change queued. Requires CS+Eng ack to apply.

Lena (CS): Ack from CS, proceeding. Priya, can you share small repro and versioned snippet?

Priya (SDK): Shared a gist with example containerized lambda that reuses client + upgrade notes. Also flagged a bug for SDK to improve serverless default for next patch.

Lena (CS): Applied bump, customer validated upgrade to v1.3.1 and reused client pattern. After ~10 minutes no more 429s during their ramp tests. I'll monitor for one hour then close.

Arjun (SE): For follow-up, add a note in our onboarding quickstart: serverless clients should reuse SDK instances and we should call out ephemeral demo token caveats.

Lena (CS): Will add to onboarding checklist and send BrightLayer a short postmortem and best-practice doc. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
